verdict.rationale: The only built-in recurring automation is Alerts, which keep watching for new research on chosen topics and can send instant email notifications (elicit-docs-3, elicit-docs-15). Users can also call the API from their own code and scripts, so recurring runs are possible only through an external scheduler (elicit-docs-34). Missing for 10: a native scheduler for recurring Research Agent or Systematic Review runs, configurable cron-style schedules, scheduling via the API or MCP, and any independent corroboration.
